subject: End markers
notes: kb/Work PB988 LANDED (wave 1015 Z2). The refuter's PARTIAL was the edition half: END FUNCTION (and the FUNCTION-ID paragraph it closes) is a COBOL-2002 introduction, accepted at --std 85 with no gate. The new construct row function-definition-2002 is recognition-fired on the FUNCTION-ID paragraph (ParseArm.VisitFunctionIdParagraph, COBOL0900; the prototype format keeps its own function-prototype-2002 row on prototypePhrase), so pb988-function-definition-85 names the edition; END FUNCTION closing a PROGRAM-ID unit is COBOL2274 (§10.6.1) at every edition. The 2002 positive pb988_end_markers writes all nine alternatives (END PROGRAM program and prototype, END FUNCTION function and prototype, END CLASS, END FACTORY, END OBJECT, END METHOD named and bare, END INTERFACE) and runs: NESTED F=14 MAKE V=5 LAST.
